items.question: What is the best aspect ratio for Instagram Stories in Lovart?
items.answer: You should select the 9:16 aspect ratio (Vertical) in the Lovart Image Generator. This ensures your content fills the entire mobile screen for maximum impact.

items.question: Can I turn a horizontal photo into a vertical Story?
items.answer: Yes! Use the 'Expand' tool. Upload your horizontal or square image, select the 9:16 ratio, and let AI generate the extended top and bottom areas naturally.

items.question: How do I make my Stories move?
items.answer: Use Lovart's 'Video Generator' or the 'Image to Video' feature. Upload your static design and choose a model like Veo 3 or Kling to add motion effects like camera pans or flowing elements.

items.question: Can I use these designs for ads?
items.answer: Absolutely. All assets generated on paid Lovart plans come with a commercial license, making them safe for Instagram Ads, Facebook Ads, and boosted posts.

items.question: Does Lovart support adding text?
items.answer: Yes. You can use the 'Text' tool on the ChatCanvas to add overlays, or use 'Text Edit' to modify existing text within an AI-generated image seamlessly.
